g.text: futuresFor(topicPartitions).forEach(future->{try {future.get();}catch (InterruptedException|ExecutionExceptione){log.error("Encountered an error while awaiting an errant record future's completion.",e);throw new ConnectException(e);}})
futuresFor(topicPartitions).forEach(future->{try {future.cancel(true);}catch (Exceptione){log.error("Encountered an error while cancelling an errant record future",e);}})
throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Reporting an errant record cannot be cancelled.");
